result.title: When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures
result.summary: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model's 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What'sUp's independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究用模型自身失败样本微调来修复 VLM，并指出 held-out 失败准确率会误导：人工审计发现 100 条失败中 37 条是标签错误，且失败样本存在措辞规律，只读问题的分类器即可答对 73.2%。据此提出 VFR——类型化最小对比失败挖掘、三名不看标签的 LLM 裁判验证、答案优先的纠正目标、带 replay 的 LoRA 微调；空间关系大幅修复，但否定与多图关系推理反而退化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其失败筛选、措辞捷径与指标失真的证据，可为 LVR 中视觉证据是否被真正使用、贡献分配与训练后能力遗忘的诊断提供具体参照；「准确率上升但依赖语言规律」的现象也提示 latent 增益需做因果核查。
